remaining_gaps: The state of five offices listed in section 1 on 2026-10-14 cannot be decided from held evidence: section 1(i) (Research and Innovative Technology Administration), 1(j) (Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation), 1(k) (Regional Administrator, Southern Region, Federal Aviation Administration), 1(l) (Director, Resource Center, Lakewood, Colorado, Federal Highway Administration) and 1(m) (Regional Administrator, Northwest Mountain Region, Federal Aviation Administration) are named offices of the Department of Transportation that may have been renamed, merged or abolished after 2009. No held statute, reorganization notice or Department of Transportation document shows whether each office existed or was succeeded on 2026-10-14; a clause listing an office that no longer exists cannot be carried as operative without that source. Needed: held current statutory or regulatory text (for example the current Department of Transportation organization provisions of 49 U.S.C. chapter 1 and 49 CFR part 1, or an FAA and FHWA reorganization notice) stating the existence or succession of each of these five offices. The held 49 CFR part 1 sections in jobs/theophilus-sources (1.27, 1.38, 1.38a, 1.45, 1.74, 1.81, 1.97) do not name them.

The packet holds no current-law record for this order (the U.S. Code search records one hit, the eCFR search none, and no CURRENT: record is in the packet's citable evidence); the order's own held text shows no end and no later instrument amends or revokes it, which would support the offices in section 1(a) to (h) and sections 2 to 4 but cannot decide the five offices above.

Section 6 directs the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, within 14 days of the order (deadline 2025-05-07), to terminate the Historically Black Colleges and Universities and Minority Serving Institutions Advisory Council. No held source shows that the Administrator did terminate the council or when; a search of the held texts for the council's name finds only the order's own texts and the 20 U.S.C. 1060 note that reprints the order, and EO 14354 (continuance of certain Federal advisory committees) and FR Doc. 2025-18033 do not name the council. A deadline is not an end, and whether the command was performed is not established, so the clause can be carried neither as operative nor as terminated with an exact first end. Needed: a held EPA charter-termination record, Federal Register notice or other dated EPA document showing the termination of that advisory council.

The remaining clauses of EO 14283 (the White House Initiative, the President's Board of Advisors on HBCUs, accountability and general provisions) are supported by the held 20 U.S.C. 1060 note and EO 14354 (2025-09-29), which continues the Board, so only section 6's second sentence blocks a submission; the first sentence of section 6 (revocation of Executive Order 14041) was performed on issuance.
